newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNOC-EC eyes overseas projects in 1997.
newsitem.headline: PNOC-EC eyes overseas projects in 1997.

text.p: The state-owned Philippine National Oil Co-Exploration Corp (PNOC-EC) said it will pursue plans to participate in overseas oil exploration projects in 1997.

"In 1997, we see ourselves as minority participants in oil exploration projects overseas with stakes of 10 to 30 percent depending upon the magnitude of investments required," Rufino Bomasang, PNOC-EC president, told Reuters on Saturday.
Bomasang said PNOC-EC has started talks with Petronas Carigali, the oil exploration arm of Malaysia's Petroliam Nasional Berhad (Petronas), for joint venture oil exploration.
"We are essentially limiting ourselves to Petronas because of their experience," Bomasang said.

The company has earmarked 306 million pesos for 1997 oil exploration investments, both at home and overseas, Bomasang said. This will include the drilling of one onshore and one offshore well in the Philippines, he added.
Bomasang added that PNOC-EC also plans to venture into coal exploration this year having recently acquired a 13,000 hectare concession in the Isabela province in the main island of Luzon.
